issue.title: Terminal permission prompts (incl. subagents) need an answerable dashboard dialog, and composer input must not be pasted into or lost around them
acceptanceCriteria: With a fixture pane showing Claude Code's permission prompt, the dialog appears with the command and reason; Allow and Deny each send the right key, and the dialog clears only after the pane confirms.
A subagent permission prompt names the subagent in the dialog.
A composer message sent while a prompt is up is held, not pasted, and is delivered after the prompt clears (test with a fixture pane).
The root cause of the lost 15:24 messages is written up in the PR, with a regression test.
Docs: the conversation UI docs (`docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md` pending-input section or the OKF `conversation-ui` concept) describe terminal permission prompts and held messages.

blocker.title: Stale registry entry after a main-thread Deny keeps held messages held forever
